{{Top}}
An '''orbital platform''' was an item of technology with military use. [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot used orbital platforms during the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], but they were vaporized by enemy [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]] soldiers. Xim's personal platform was the only one that wasn't destroyed. The [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurian]] historian [[S. V. Skynx/Legends|Skynx]] managed to examine one war droid recovered from this platform.
